text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I came to the shrine to offer a prayer, bringing along Fusaichi Pandora, who has been in a bit of a slump lately.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, aren't we good already?
Visiting a shrine over and over isn't gonna change anything.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry and go home~.
choice_data_list: Wait here, I'll go pay our respects at the shrine for you.
I'll go make the shrine visit for you, so just wait here

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Please hurry up, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, there are ema plaques hereâª
I wonder what people wished for, let's see, let's see~...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"‘I hope you win the next race.’
‘You'll definitely get the Triple Crown!’ ‘Win the Shuka Sho!’"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Of course they'd write something like this~.
............Hm?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "May my Trainer stay happy and healthy from here on out!", huh.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Huh... So some girls write them for their Trainers... ......"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...That's it♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Excuse me~, one ema plaque, please!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Welcooome home~♪
Hey hey, how're you feeling?
choice_data_list: How am I doing? Now that you mention it, I feel pretty good.
How am I doing? Now that you mention it, I feel pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because we prayed with all our hearts,
both body and mind feel lighter somehow.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I see! Knew it♪
You'd better be grateful, okay, Trainer?♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Hmm, I wonder why~♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ Somehow, I think I'm
getting into a good mood too♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora was in a strangely good mood.
Afterward, perhaps thanks to the prayers,
her condition returned to normal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing my prayers, I returned to Fusaichi Pandora.
Perhaps because I put my entire heart and soul into the prayer,
I felt utterly exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Good work~! Hey, hey, how are you feeling?
Don't you feel super refreshed?
choice_data_list: I feel a little tired, I guess...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Why, why, why~!
That makes zero sense~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh... Now I feel even more sluggish!
Booo, I say, boooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fusaichi Pandora was in a foul mood for some reason.
Her desperate prayers seemingly went unanswered,
and she remained off her game.
